text: 1、市场全天低开高走，三大指数均涨超1%，科创50涨近5%。半导体芯片股持续反弹，大为股份、金海通、康强电子等涨停。算力硬件股拉升，工业富联、汇绿生态、金安国纪等涨停。智能驾驶概念活跃，索菱股份、浙江世宝、兴民智通等涨停。贵金属板块走强，四川黄金、金一文化、盛达资源等涨停。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超3700股飘红，今日成交2.68万亿。截止收盘沪指涨1.47%，深成指涨1.86%，创业板指涨1.32%。 2、板块概念方面，贵金属、半导体芯片、算力硬件、消费电子等板块涨幅居前，银行、油气、中药、白酒等板块逆势下跌。 3、两市共3427只个股上涨，103只个
text_en: 1. The market opened low and climbed throughout the day, with all three major indices rising over 1% and the STAR 50 up nearly 5%. Semiconductor chip stocks continued to rebound, with Dawei Co., Jinhaitong, Kangqiang Electronics and others hitting the daily limit. Computing hardware stocks rallied, with Foxconn Industrial Internet, Huilv Ecology, Jin'an Guojie and others hitting the limit. Intelligent driving concept was active, with Suoling Co., Zhejiang Shibao, Xingmin Zhitong and others hitting the limit. Precious metals sector strengthened, with Sichuan Gold, Jinyi Culture, Shengda Resources and others hitting the limit. More stocks rose than fell, with over 3,700 stocks in Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets in the green; today's turnover was 2.68 trillion yuan. At the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.47%, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.86%, and the ChiNext rose 1.32%. 2. In terms of sectors and concepts, precious metals, semiconductor chips, computing hardware, consumer electronics and other sectors led gains, while banks, oil and gas, traditional Chinese medicine, baijiu and other sectors fell against the trend. 3.
